facts.text: The resort is located in the Allegheny Mountains of Pennsylvania.
facts.excerpt: Located in the Allegheny Mountains of Pennsylvania, Omni Bedford Springs Resort & Spa is the perfect place to reconnect.

facts.text: The resort is home to the first indoor swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: We are home to the first indoor swimming pool, one of the country

facts.text: The resort has one of the country's first golf courses.
facts.excerpt: one of the country’s first golf courses

facts.text: Spa treatments are inspired by the natural healing of springs first used by Native Americans.
facts.excerpt: spa treatments inspired by the natural healing of springs first used by Native Americans

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites pair Pennsylvania heritage with modern amenities and expansive balconies.
facts.excerpt: Guest rooms and suites embody the heritage of Pennsylvania coupled with modern amenities and expansive balconies.

facts.text: Downtown Bedford is on the resort's doorstep, with a variety of historic tours within walking distance.
facts.excerpt: Guests can also explore the local area easily, with downtown Bedford on your doorstep and a variety of historic tours walking distance.

facts.text: Resort View Rooms are in the historic wing.
facts.excerpt: Stay in our most popular accommodations featuring timeless décor that welcomes guests to our historic wing.

facts.text: Deluxe rooms have large windows with views of the hillside.
facts.excerpt: Breathtaking views of the hillside can be seen from your room through large picturesque windows.

facts.text: Golfweek magazine named the historic Old Course the #1 Golf Resort Course in Pennsylvania.
facts.excerpt: Named #1 Golf Resort Course in Pennsylvania by Golfweek magazine, our historic Old Course offers breathtaking views and challenges for all levels.

facts.text: Springs Eternal Spa covers 30,000 square feet, with the Bedford Baths and a spa lounge.
facts.excerpt: Our 30,000 square foot Springs Eternal Spa is the ultimate retreat. Take a dip in the Bedford Baths or relax in our spa lounge after your treatment.

facts.text: The resort spans 2,200 acres.
facts.excerpt: Explore the sights of our 2,200-acre, world-class resort in Bedford, PA.

facts.text: The resort has indoor and outdoor pools, and the outdoor pool has cabanas.
facts.excerpt: Outdoor Pool With Cabanas

facts.text: Amenities include a tennis court, a fitness center, and biking leisure trails and outdoor activities.
facts.excerpt:
- A full-sized tennis court
- A fully-equipped fitness center
- Biking leisure trails and outdoor activities

facts.text: The resort offers family-friendly resort activities.
facts.excerpt: Family-friendly resort activities

facts.text: The resort is in southern Pennsylvania's Cumberland Valley, about 90 minutes from Pittsburgh, two hours from Washington, D.C., and three hours from Philadelphia.
facts.excerpt: located in South Pennsylvania’s scenic Cumberland Valley, about 90 minutes from Pittsburgh, two hours from Washington, D.C., and three hours from Philadelphia.

facts.text: Guests must be 21 years of age to book a room.
facts.excerpt: Guests must be 21 years of age to book a room.

facts.text: Dogs are welcome, with a special dog menu created by the chefs; pet-friendly rooms are only in the Anderson House.
facts.excerpt: Pet-friendly rooms are available only in the Anderson House. Luxury spa rooms or suites are not pet-friendly.

facts.text: Dining venues serve local produce and signature drinks alongside views of the resort.
facts.excerpt: dining venues offer the finest local produce and signature drinks, served alongside spectacular views from our Bedford resort.

facts.text: Six indoor and outdoor dining venues.
facts.excerpt: Six welcoming indoor and outdoor dining venues

facts.text: Seven dining outlets: four full-service restaurants, a coffee shop, a lobby bar and a pool grill.
facts.excerpt: Seven dining outlets - four full-service restaurants, a coffee shop, a lobby bar and a pool grill

facts.text: Travel + Leisure World's Best Awards 2024 Winner.
facts.excerpt: Travel + Leisure World's Best Awards 2024 Winner

facts.text: Premier Luxury Spa rooms are described as the most serene stay at the resort.
facts.excerpt: Luxurious finishes and upscale room amenities make this the most serene stay available at Omni Bedford Springs.
